summary.result: The results revealed that elderly migration can be explained not only by areal characteristics but also by spatial interaction considering the population, distances, and amenities of surrounding areas.
summary.background: An areal elderly migration model (AEMM) was developed to assess the demand of rural development projects targeted towards elderly people.
summary.method: The AEMM was developed with adaptation of the gravity model to represent spatial interaction regarding amenities.
